name: Rock-Paper-Scissors
description: 2-player, 3-strategy zero-sum game. No pure NE; unique mixed NE at (1/3, 1/3, 1/3).
source: Osborne & Rubinstein (1994). A Course in Game Theory, p. 34.

mixedNashProfiles.derivation: By symmetry and zero-sum, each player must mix uniformly to keep the opponent indifferent across all strategies.

notes: Zero-sum: utilities[0][i] + utilities[1][i] = 0 for every profile i.
MixedNash2x2Module cannot handle this game (requires exactly 2 strategies per player).
